title: Keyboard Sound Profiling App Survey
description:
Hi all! I am a Software Engineering graduation student at Hogeschool Windesheim (Netherlands), conducting an open research project on acoustic telemetry and sound profiling for mechanical keyboards.
This survey takes approximately 2 to 3 minutes. Your answers are completely anonymous, not used for commercial purposes, and strictly analyzed for academic software architecture research. Thank you for helping out!

items.title: How would you describe your experience with mechanical keyboards?
options: Newcomer / Beginner (bought a prebuilt / first board)
Enthusiast (customized a few boards, basic modding)
Expert / Custom Builder (built multiple customs, advanced tuning)

items.title: How do you currently decide which modifications (e.g., lubing, tape mod, foam, plate swaps) to apply to your keyboard? (Checkboxes - Select all that apply)
options: YouTube sound tests / build streams
Pure trial-and-error (trying mods and listening)
Sound test recordings of my own board
Recommendations on Reddit / Discord / Forums
I haven't modified my keyboard yet / None
labels: Sound test recordings of my own board

items.title: In my experience, YouTube sound tests accurately represent how a keyboard will sound on my own desk.
What is your preferred keyboard sound signature?
options: Deep & Low-pitched ("Thock")
Crisp & High-pitched ("Clack")
Pop / Marbly
Muted / Silent
Balanced / No specific preference

items.title: Which features would you consider most valuable in an acoustic analysis app?
options: Real-time frequency spectrum & acoustic analysis via smartphone microphone
Objective classification of sound characteristics (pitch, decay, sharpness)
Before-and-after (A/B) comparison of modifications
Tailored hardware modification suggestions to reach a target sound
Reference sound library of switches, plates, and mods
labels: Real-time frequency spectrum & acoustic analysis via smartphone microphone
Tailored hardware modification suggestions to reach a target sound

items.title: Which hardware modifications would you find most valuable to compare side-by-side (A/B testing)? (Select all that apply)
options: Switch types (e.g., linear vs. tactile vs. clicky)
Lubed vs. unlubed switches
Plate materials (e.g., FR4, aluminum, brass, polycarbonate)
Foam & dampening configurations (e.g., case foam, PE sheet, tape mod)
Keycap profiles & materials (e.g., Cherry vs. SA / PBT vs. ABS)
None / Not interested in A/B testing

items.title: How important are the following aspects to you? (1 = Not important at all, 5 = Extremely important)
rows: Live visual feedback while recording (e.g., an animated frequency spectrum responding as you press keys)
Detailed acoustic telemetry reports (frequency spectrum, resonance, decay time)
Offline capability (record and view basic acoustic metrics without internet)
Clear, actionable hardware modding advice based on your sound

items.title: What is your preferred format for receiving sound recommendations?
options: Concrete modding steps (e.g., "Apply 2 layers of tape mod, lube switch housings")
Hardware component advice (e.g., switch type suggestions, plate material swaps)
Visual acoustic charts (e.g., target curve vs. your current sound spectrum)
Profile matching (e.g., "Your sound currently matches 85% with a stock aluminum build")

items.title: Do you have any specific features or unique ideas you would like to see in this app?
Optional: Follow-up Interview
